content: In the last few months, hundreds of reports have appeared all over the internet, all claiming to see the same thing in their Minecraft oceans - a sea monster called The Leviathan. But is it just a massive hoax, or is there something more to it? I'm going to find out. Voice of Hummer: @schpoody Voice of Arronax: @jumperwho ORIGINAL MUSIC BY: Ben Bracey (@benbraceymusic on instagram) https://soundcloud.com/benbraceymusic/sets/hunting-the-leviathan-original Download all the builds in this video for $5 on both Java and Bedrock!!: https://maps.wifies.net/products/the-leviathan DO NOT READ BELOW FOR SPOILERS: Well well well here we are again. I think this video is interesting in that the first 12 minutes can't prepare you for the remaining hour; as in the pacing is very different/the style totally shifts. So we'll see how that goes... I'm really fond of the ending I like how that last 10 minutes turned out. That final scene with hummer was inspired by one of my favorite short stories, "Hell is the Absence of God" by Ted Chiang. There are definitely some parts of the video that I think could be a little better like maybe the dialogue is a bit dragged but overall I'm pretty satisfied with the majority of the video. Thematically, I think you might be able to tell the kind of story I was playing around with, but I was also hugely inspired by the Lochness Monster. Probably some of my favorite parts of research for this video was reading the Lochness Monster wiki and learning more about the kind of theories/tools people use to look for it. The F3 scene on hummer's boat was inspired by all the sonar and stuff people use to check for Nessie. Also just a MASSIVE shoutout to schpood for all the hours and care he poured into this video. I'm so thankful for the enthusiasm and feedback he gave and the video would be so much worse without him. And thank you to my discord server members for making (almost) all of the fake reports you see in this video. They were super creative and did a way better job than I could have. ➤➤ Twitter: https://twitter.com/wifiestwt ➤➤ Discord: https://discord.gg/zAWUuWb ➤➤Links: Want to listen to or license the music I use? Check it out here: https://www.epidemicsound.com/community/playlist/?_us=Affiliate&_usx=1xis5q&utm_source=1xis5q&utm_medium=organicambassador&utm_campaign=1xis5q&playlist=uad3vzakh605efvoqoi24llhnpr9lm2y LEMMiNO - Blackout https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RsVVcsVDt-s CC BY-SA 4.0 Water Lantern designed by: @MythicalPingu Submarine tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6ud22yz0p7s All screenshots/reddit posts/websites in this video do NOT exist and were made for the sake of the video. If any link redirects to an actual website - that is coincidental and do not treat it as "official"; it was just put in the video make the world feel more real. This is NOT series called Minecraft VVSauce where I explore random features of Minecraft. Not Secret Minecraft things or Minecraft lore (like Game Theory) or Escape Rooms, but an ARG that isn't an ARG but it's actually unfiction - a genre pretending to be real that isn't real but we all pretend to be real. This is the search for the leviathan. I hope you enjoy
chineseTitle: | 寻 | 找 | 利 | 维 | 坦 |
chineseContent: 在过去的几个月里，互联网上出现了数百份报告，所有报告都声称在他们的 Minecraft 海洋中看到了同样的东西 - 一种名为利维坦的海怪。但这只是一个巨大的骗局，还是另有隐情？我要去找出答案。 Hummer 之声：@schpoody Arronax 之声：@jumperwho 原创音乐：Ben Bracey（instagram 上的@benbraceymusic） https://soundcloud.com/benbraceymusic/sets/hunting-the-leviathan-original 在 Java 和 Bedrock 上以 5 美元的价格下载此视频中的所有版本！！：https://maps.wifies.net/products/the-leviathan 不要请阅读以下内容以防剧透： 好吧好吧，我们又来了。我认为这个视频很有趣，因为前 12 分钟无法让你为接下来的一小时做好准备；因为节奏非常不同/风格完全改变。所以我们会看看事情会如何发展...我真的很喜欢结局，我喜欢最后 10 分钟的结果。最后的嗡嗡声场景的灵感来自于我最喜欢的短篇小说之一，特德·蒋的《地狱是上帝的缺席》。我认为视频中肯定有一些部分可以做得更好，比如对话可能有点拖沓，但总的来说，我对视频的大部分内容都非常满意。从主题上讲，我认为你也许能​​够讲述我正在玩的那种故事，但我也受到尼斯湖水怪的巨大启发。也许我在这个视频的研究中最喜欢的一些部分是阅读 Lochness Monster wiki 并了解更多关于人们用来寻找它的理论/工具的信息。悍马船上的 F3 场景的灵感来自于人们用来检查尼斯湖水怪的所有声纳和东西。同时也是对他在这段视频中投入的所有时间和关怀的大力赞扬。我非常感谢他的热情和反馈
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 YouTube 热门视频信号，适合用于观察大众注意力、内容叙事、传播主题和跨平台选题机会。
